description: Which version of ASPERN is answering, each part under its own name: the public ChatGPT plugin version with when it was first served and its package id, how many tools were approved with it and how many more are served awaiting approval, the MCP server version, a hash of the tool list each surface serves now (it changes when, and only when, a tool, description or schema changes), the deployed backend build (which moves with every deploy and is never a plugin version), and the version of each method (risk score, assessment document, rating, collateral, exit simulator, depositors, alert rules). Free.
name: plugin_info

answerLead.description: SINCE 2026-11-28: at most three lines before the full answer, from its own fields: `text`, `result`, `risks` (up to two), `asOf`, `coverage`, `unknowns` (up to two) and `deprecatedFields` (legacy duplicates this answer still carries). The full answer governs. Added by this MCP server; the REST route behind the tool does not carry it.

backend.description: build, environment, says: a build is not a plugin version.

lead.description: The versions in one sentence, the plugin first.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

methodology.description: One version per method, keyed by method.

plugin.description: packageId, publicVersion, releasedAt, releasedBuild, previousVersion, url, approvedTools, toolsServed, toolsAwaitingApproval.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

title: Which ASPERN version is answering
